sources.name: KCR Community Resources - Immigrant & Settlement Services
sources.notes: Central Okanagan's main immigrant/settlement services agency - Volunteer Friendship for Newcomers, Community Connections, pre-employment and tax/tenancy workshops. Activated 2026-09-09 using the existing parse_event_espresso parser - no new code needed, just flipping the kind. REGRESSION found 2026-10-21: this URL now 404s, and the site's full /wp-json/ namespace list no longer includes any 'ee'/Event Espresso route at all - /events/ is also 404. The site was rebuilt since (now WP Engine hosting + Avada/Fusion Builder, a different stack than the Event Espresso-era site), and appears to have dropped its public events calendar entirely in the redesign - a web search found no current public workshop calendar anywhere for KCR. Reverted kind to probe; this is a genuine regression, not a parser bug - re-check periodically in case the calendar comes back under a new URL.

sources.name: Downtown Kelowna Association
sources.notes: WordPress site, wp-json/tribe route 404s 2026-08-26 - not The Events Calendar plugin, custom events template instead. Runs the Thursday Night Market (May-Sept, ends Sept 3 2026) and Meet Me on Bernard programming - good social fit once a feed or reliable scrape point is found. UNBLOCKED 2026-10-21: it's actually a custom Elementor+JetEngine 'events' post type (same family as cci-ottawa's jet_events, but a different page template with no Date:/Time:/Venue headings to anchor on - no venue/price field exists at all). New `downtown_kelowna_events` parser discovers posts via the plain WP REST route (`/wp-json/wp/v2/events`, more reliable than this site's own `/events/feed/` which is just the empty WordPress comments feed) and reads the flat ordered run of jet-listing-dynamic-field values on each post. Mostly touring musicals/shows well out from today (Spongebob/Shrek in Jul 2027) rather than newcomer programming - cost defaults 'Ticketed' and is in TICKETED_KINDS so it isn't filtered to zero on cost alone. BUG FOUND AND FIXED same day: the parser originally required exactly 6 dynamic-field values and silently skipped any single-day event (only 4 values: date/dow/time/time, no separate end-date) - that was 31 of this site's 40 events (78%), including 'The Day of the Dead in Mexico' (Oct 29), which a ChatGPT-researched events report had flagged as a missing multicultural recommendation. Fixed to handle both the 4- and 6-value shapes; real count went from 2 to 32 kept. NOTE: the site's separately-run 'Winter Street Market & Light Up' (their biggest annual event, ~Nov 28) is NOT in this CPT at all - it's a different kind of BIA event, not one of the venue/ticketed listings here, and its own page (downtownkelowna.com/winter-market/) has no date posted yet as of this check.

sources.name: Tourism Kelowna Events
sources.notes: wp-json/tribe/events route 301-redirects rather than returning JSON 2026-08-26 (openresty edge in front); aggregates festivals across the whole Central Okanagan including Center of Gravity and other major festivals. RE-CHECKED 2026-10-21: not WordPress - runs Simpleview, a common DMO/tourism-board CMS. FULL API FOUND same day via the browser tool's network log while loading /events/calendar/ in a real session: `GET /includes/rest_v2/plugins_events_events_by_date/find/?json=<mongo-style query>&token=<public client-side token, same one visible in the page's own moduleDataJSON>` - same-origin, no separate host. Query shape: `filter.active`, `filter.$and[0].categories.catId.$in` (the site's own category whitelist, excludes noisy ones like 'Happy Hours & Specials' catId 76 - without it a date-range-only query returns 8695 docs of mostly recurring bar specials vs 747 with the whitelist), `date_range.start/end` (Mongo `{$date:...}` ISO), `options.limit/skip` for paging (300 max per page), `options.fields` to pick the response shape, `options.sort`. Response: `docs.count` + `docs.docs[]` with title/url/categories/city/admission/address1/startTime/endTime/startDate/endDate/nextDate - genuinely rich, well-structured data. **BUT it's Akamai Bot Manager-gated and this is a real hard dead end for automation**: a bare curl 403s even with full matching browser headers (UA/Accept/Accept-Language/Referer/X-Requested-With) - confirmed 2026-10-21 - and Firecrawl's own stealth-proxy browser engine ALSO failed outright ('All scraping engines failed'). Only a genuine live browser session that had already loaded the real page got through. Same category as the documented Church Center dead end in the probe-playbook: known API, CORS/WAF-gated to the org's own app, no stdlib or headless-automation workaround found. Pulled the full current dataset (747 events, all categories, Oct 2026-Jan 2027) through a live browser session this pass and hand-picked the best few as manual_events below - this needs a manual re-pull each time, it cannot run in the unattended weekly crawl.
